description: Canonical sensitivity vocabulary and fixtures shared by the Spring approval workflow engine (which scores a document when an approval process starts) and the Python Generation module's sensitive_policy. The keyword list is a verbatim copy of sensitive_policy._SENSITIVE_TERMS at the moment this contract was adopted. Extend the Python vocabulary first, then update this file so both sides move together: rag-chatbot-fastapi/tests/test_contracts.py keeps this file locked to the Python implementation, and com.openvie.api.workflow keeps its runtime copy byte-identical to this file.
